in_marathi.name: Aravind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aravind हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aravind is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘aravinda’ and ‘indra’. ‘Aravinda’ means radiant, and ‘indra’ is the name of the king of gods in Hindu mythology. Thus, Aravind can be interpreted as a peaceful, radiant god or a person with divine qualities.
